name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Use a 2px solid #005fcc focus ring with a 1px inner glow at 20% opacity. This keeps the ring visible on patterned backgrounds without adding distracting glow. The trade-off is slightly less crisp edges, but the glow improves visibility for users with low contrast sensitivity.

name: Reader
text: The 2px ring with inner glow still risks disappearing on patterned backgrounds. A 3px solid ring at #004499 with 4.5:1 contrast against white backgrounds would guarantee visibility for all users. Settle it with a live contrast test on the most complex background in the design system.
